title: weekend life at my cottage - thoughts on loving your appearance
en: hello everyone today i had some time off and decided to take you along on some adventures since i moved here i've been teaching myself to skate i'm not very good at it but the frozen lake is a wonderful place to practice especially when there's a sprinkle of new fallen snow over the ice it doesn't let you gain too much speed instead you can work on your balance as you can see eiger was very excited to
be on the lake today he first experienced the snow last year when i brought him home as a puppy and it has quickly become his favorite season do

did you know that if you light a candle when you glimpse the first star in a clear night sky the kindly moon rabbit may just stop by your home while you sleep and sprinkle fairy dust on your forehead filling your dreams with whimsy and delight at least when i was a child i was definitely convinced that this would happen and i still love to light candles just in case the next morning i woke up with the sun and took a long walk with iger i think that there are few joys more deeply felt than a morning walk with a

beloved pet it is one of my favorite parts of my day i recently told luke that i was missing my visits to the mountains so he gave me some crystals that he had found to remind me of the peaks now obstructed by so much snow these crystals probably look nothing like the ones you find in shops and that is because commercial crystals have gone through a very rigorous process of chemical cleaning

the end result is spectacular but i personally enjoy these more natural versions as well they have their own unique type of beauty in a strange way these natural crystals remind me to value my own imperfections it is so easy to compare our natural selves with the flawless imagery that we see in edited photographs and advertisements but those images like polished and cut crystals come from a labored process of changing something from its natural state to something different while i respect that a lot of these images are art i also am aware that much of what we see in my culture is an advertisement

and while it may be beautiful it sometimes omits the origin story that we all have every little blemish is part of our personal legend just as each divet on the face of this crystal is intrinsic to its formation you may not have noticed because i try

not to showcase it but the tip of one of my fingers is slightly malformed this was due to an accident as a child and i was deeply self-conscious when i was much younger i don't see it as something beautiful but i now understand that it is part of my story and i wouldn't want it any other way similarly by being biracial my features are a combination of my ancestors who come from very different parts of the world if my eyes were bigger my nose smaller i would lose the imprint of their lives their stories and their appearance i would feel less connected i hope that whoever you are you love your naturally given features and learn

to embrace your imperfections and see that things you may wish were different are actually just part of your legend your origin story and the evidence of the thousand lives that lived before you thank you for sharing a little bit of this day with me
i will be thinking of you and i will see you next week you
zh: 大家好，今天我有一段时间休息，自从我搬到这里后，我决定带你们去冒险，我一直在自学滑冰，我不太擅长，但是结冰的湖是一个练习的好地方，特别是当冰上有一些新落下的雪时，它不会让你获得太多的速度，而是可以锻炼你的平衡，因为你可以看到艾格峰非常兴奋
今天在湖边，去年我把他带回家时，他还是个小狗，第一次经历了雪，这很快就成为他最喜欢的季节了
你知道吗，当你在晴朗的夜空中瞥见第一颗星星时，如果你点燃一支蜡烛，善良的月亮兔子可能会在你睡觉时到你家来，在你的额头上撒上仙尘，让你的梦想充满奇思妙想和喜悦，至少在我还是个孩子的时候，我确信这会发生，我仍然喜欢点燃蜡烛，以防第二天早上我在阳光下醒来，和艾格一起散步，我想，没有什么比早上和艾格一起散步更能感受到快乐的了。
心爱的宠物，这是我一天中最喜欢的部分之一，我最近告诉卢克，我错过了去山里的旅行，所以他给了我一些他发现的水晶，让我想起现在被这么多雪遮住的山峰，这些水晶可能看起来不像你在商店里找到的那​​些，那是因为商业水晶经过了非常严格的化学清洁过程
最终的结果是壮观的，但我个人也喜欢这些更自然的版本，它们以一种奇怪的方式有自己独特的美感，这些天然晶体提醒我重视自己的缺陷，很容易将我们的自然自我与我们在编辑的照片和广告中看到的完美图像进行比较，但像抛光和切割晶体这样的图像来自将某些东西从其自然状态改变为不同状态的劳动过程，虽然我尊重这些图像中的很多都是艺术，但我也意识到我们在我的文化中看到的很多东西都是广告
虽然它可能很美丽，但有时会忽略起源故事，即我们每个人都有的每一个小瑕疵都是我们个人传奇的一部分，就像这种晶体表面上的每一个凹陷都是其形成所固有的，你可能没有注意到，因为我尝试

不是为了展示它，但我的一个手指尖有点畸形，这是由于小时候的一次意外，当我年轻的时候，我有深深的自我意识，我不认为它是美丽的东西，但我现在明白，这是我故事的一部分，我不希望它以任何其他方式类似，因为是混血儿，我的特征是我的祖先的组合，他们来自世界不同的地方，如果我的眼睛更大，我的鼻子更小，我会失去他们生活的印记，他们的故事和他们的外表，我会感觉到联系较少，我希望无论你是谁，你都喜欢你天生的特征并学习
拥抱你的不完美，并看到你可能希望有所不同的事物实际上只是你传奇的一部分，你的起源故事，以及在你之前生活过的数千人的证据，谢谢你与我分享这一天的一点点
